name: Damilola Rahman
role: Black market pharmaceutical dealer and street pharmacist â€” meds, supplements, unscheduled compounds
location: The Narrows, Blackpipe Corridor, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Damilola Rahman is young enough that it still shows â€” there's a looseness to him, an unresolved quality, like something that hasn't quite hardened into its final shape. He is tall, lean, with the dark skin and angular jaw of his Tanzanian grandfather and his Filipino grandmother's round cheeks, a combination that makes him look younger than he is and which he has mostly given up being frustrated about. His ears are tipped with small black cat-ear points â€” geneware done in a parlor on a dare when he was nineteen, which he now can't imagine removing. He keeps his hair mid-length and loose, usually damp, because he is always running slightly late.

He operates from three locations in rotation â€” a corner in the Narrows, a back table in a noodle shop in Blackpipe Corridor, and a patch near the old water reclamation junction on the Corridor's south end â€” and keeps no fixed stall because fixed stalls have fixed addresses. He knows more about pharmacology than most licensed clinicians, taught himself from pirated Helix Biosystems training modules and a mentor who has since retired. He is genuinely trying to help people who cannot afford clinical pricing â€” and he is also genuinely dealing recreational compounds for profit â€” and he holds both of these truths without significant cognitive dissonance, which either speaks to moral flexibility or a realistic understanding of how survival works.

core_fears: Being arrested and losing the operation before he's built anything sturdy enough to survive without him
Giving someone the wrong thing and hurting them â€” this is not abstract, it lives in him
core_desires: To run a legitimate clinic one day â€” he knows exactly what it would look like, down to the layout and the sliding-scale fee structure
To sleep eight hours without a comm alert
coping_mechanisms: Fixates on the people he has genuinely helped â€” runs the list when things are bad
Dark jokes that land precisely because they're not entirely jokes
blind_spots: Underestimates his own risk tolerance â€” takes chances he would advise clients against
Is more emotionally attached to his clients than is professionally safe
psychology.secret: Four months ago a client came to him in acute overdose crisis on a compound he didn't sell her. He stabilized her using everything he had, stayed with her for six hours, and when she was through the worst of it she told him her supplier's name. He has been building a dossier on that supplier since, with no clear plan for what to do with it â€” he is not a violent person and he is not an informant, and the space between those two things is where he is stuck.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Casual, warm, clinical when talking about compounds â€” the vocabulary shift is notable and a little jarring. Uses a lot of 'like' and 'basically' and 'no, listen' when animated. Swears cheerfully.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when comfortable, careful when discussing medications â€” he slows down for dosages like he's reading from an internal teleprompter.
verbal_tics: Refers to all his regular clients by their ailment in his head, calls them by name out loud â€” his private shorthand sometimes leaks
example_lines: 'No, listen, this is not the same compound, the molecular structure is like â€” okay, imagine the other one is a door and this one is a door that opens the wrong way. You need to know that.'
'I can get you that. Give me until Thursday. And drink water, I mean it, drink actual water.'

story_hooks: The dossier on the bad supplier is now substantial enough to be dangerous â€” to Zuberi, if it's found â€” and he needs somewhere to put it that isn't on his person

A corporate clinic has opened a 'community access' popup in the Narrows, underpricing everything and offering free diagnostics â€” and Zuberi is watching his client list shrink and trying to figure out what the clinic actually wants before he finds out the hard way
narrative_function: Resource for medical supplies outside clinical channels. Information source for what's circulating in the Narrows chemically and otherwise. Character study in the ethics of harm reduction in a predatory economy.
augmentations: Cat-ear points, black (geneware, cosmetic). No other augmentations â€” he has spent money on these things and it has always gone to something more urgent.
daily_life: He rotates between his three spots on a rough weekly schedule he shares with trusted clients via a dead-drop comm channel. He spends mornings acquiring stock â€” legal supplements through a legitimate channel he cultivates carefully, unscheduled compounds through three separate suppliers he never introduces to each other. He is chronically sleep-deprived.
affiliation: Independent; loosely affiliated with the Blackpipe Corridor residents network; pays an informal fee to the local Oxidian Market Guild chapter not to be reported

decision_rules: Do no harm â€” genuinely, not as a slogan. Will not sell to someone visibly in crisis without triaging first
Keep the suppliers separate so no single arrest collapses the whole supply chain
Never front on a price principle â€” inconsistent pricing is a security vulnerability
escalation_ladder: Talks his way out â€” he is good at this and deploys it first
Gets very still and very polite â€” a register shift that experienced Narrows residents recognize as a warning
Runs. He is fast and he knows the Corridor better than anyone looking for him.

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Friendly, quick to joke, takes a beat before trusting anyone with anything real
interpersonal_modes.friends: Becomes a slightly exhausting amount of care â€” checks in, remembers details, shows up when you're sick with something from the bag

stress_responses.low: Eats something â€” stress manifests as hunger for him, which is useful for reminding him to eat
stress_responses.medium: Runs his client list mentally, prioritizes who needs contact, uses action as regulation
stress_responses.high: Makes very fast decisions he will second-guess later at great length

contradictions: Believes in systems and structures â€” wants to build the proper clinic, resents the broken healthcare economy â€” while depending entirely on working outside any structure for his own survival
habits: Leaves a compound-offering â€” a small vial of something common and non-lethal â€” at the E.L.F. shrine near the Corridor junction, addressed to what he calls the Healer, a health-spirit he's not sure he believes in but addresses anyway
Compulsively checks his stock count at the start and end of each rotation
breaking_points: Someone dying because they couldn't access care he could have provided
The dossier being used against someone other than its subject

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Rebar Rose' Improvised Spike Mace

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian with significant South Asian ancestry, complemented by Indigenous American heritage. The genetic diaspora creates striking feature harmony: East Asian facial geometry and bone structure form the foundation, enriched by South Asian skin depth and warmth, with subtle Indigenous American characteristics visible in cheekbone prominence and facial proportions. He reads as visibly mixed-heritage, features that reflect the Ubiquitous Diaspora rather than any single regional origin.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, long-limbed with minimal body fat. The build of someone who forgets to eat regularly and moves constantly. Defined shoulders and chest, but no deliberate musculature â€” it's the leanness of motion, not training.
physical_description.hair_style: Mid-length, loose waves, usually damp or freshly dried. Worn unstyled, parted vaguely in the center. Often falls across his face when he bends over his work.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with golden undertones â€” the result of East Asian and South Asian ancestry blending with Indigenous American heritage. Complex saturation that shifts with light, alive with warmth. Uneven from irregular sleep and sun exposure across multiple outdoor locations.
physical_description.complexion: Strong East Asian facial geometry softened by South Asian fullness in the lower face, with Indigenous American prominence in the cheekbones creating a distinctive angular-yet-rounded facial structure. The combination reads younger than his 24 years. Perpetual dark circles under his eyes. A faint shadow of stubble most days â€” shaving is a luxury when you're running late. Minor acne scarring on his jaw from his late teens. Nose shows East Asian structure with subtle bridge definition.
distinguishing_marks: Small black cat-ear points grafted to the tips of both ears, angled backward slightly. The geneware is cosmetic, clean work but not high-tier. Done in a parlor on a dare at nineteen, now essential to how he sees himself.
A thin white scar running horizontally across the inside of his left wrist, approximately 4cm long. A story he doesn't tell.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cat-ear points only. Everything else is baseline human biology. His pharmaceutical knowledge doesn't show â€” it lives in his hands and his memory.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually in motion, even when standing still. A slight forward lean as though always about to move somewhere more urgent. Fidgets with vials, capsules, or whatever's in his pockets. His hands are steady â€” a pharmacist's hands â€” but his overall energy is scattered, restless. When he focuses on a customer or a transaction, it's sudden and complete, like a cat's attention snapping to movement. Otherwise, he seems to be three locations ahead of where he actually is.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 streetwear, practical and worn. Usually black or grey cargo pants with working pockets (essential for inventory rotation). Hoodies and layered thermal shirts, often partially unzipped. A particular affection for a faded teal windbreaker that's seen three years of Blackpipe Corridor weather. Worn sneakers, replaced frequently because he walks constantly. A small satchel he keeps close â€” genuine leather, worn soft, carries his rotation stock. No jewelry except for a simple steel ring on his right index finger (the hand he uses to dispense). Clothes are clean but unstudied, the uniform of someone who dresses in the dark or while already thinking about something else.
